verdict.rationale: Navan's own docs describe unified handling of card transactions, manual expenses, receipts, and reimbursements within a single platform/API (navan-docs-4, navan-docs-8, navan-docs-9, navan-docs-24), implying expenses converge into one system, but no evidence explicitly confirms automatic itinerary-linked report assembly from bookings+cards+receipts without manual reconciliation steps.  Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic itinerary-to-expense-report linkage, and independent/hands-on confirmation that receipts and card charges auto-match to trip itineraries without manual effort.
